overview_description: Download the file attached to any note, as base64, by the attachment's uuid.
intro: Note attachments are the files added to notes on accounts, orders, invoices and other records. You can download any of them by its uuid. This area has 1 endpoint, and all seven SDKs call it.
warning: **An attachment stays readable after its note is deleted, and after the record the note belongs to is deleted.** Only the attachment's own status is checked.
notes: **One route serves the attachments of every note.** It does not matter which record the note belongs to.
**The file comes back as base64.** Decode `note_attachment.base64` to get the bytes; `name` and `size` sit beside it.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a note attachment
endpoints.summary: Retrieves the file attached to any note, as base64.
endpoints.description: Name the file by the `uuid` a note's `attachments` entry carries, whatever record the note belongs to. The file comes back under `note_attachment`, with its `name`, `size` and its contents in `base64`.

id.description: The attachment's uuid, the same value as in the path.
